hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: A credible interval is a posterior probability statement for the parameter. Credibility premium formula is tomorrow.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 5.1.5
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Posterior for a risk parameter θ is Normal(0.10, 0.02²). (1) Construct an approximate 95% equal-tailed credible interval for θ. (2) Refuse: 'A 95% credible interval means that in repeated samples the random interval covers θ 95% of the time' without noting the Bayesian reading.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) ≈ 0.10 ± 1.96·0.02 → about (0.0608, 0.1392). (2) Refuse: that is the frequentist coverage slogan for a confidence interval; a credible interval is a posterior probability statement about θ given the data.
